activity_summary: Heminges called from Aldermanbury. The court is at Whitehall because the Queen came up yesterday. My lord of Huntingdon is dead in the north, and she would tell the Countess herself. You had already heard from Kettleby's boy that she goes back Monday and that the players are looked for at Richmond. His tilt-boat is Davy Gannet's, for Wednesday's flood, with a deposit down and no sum spoken. If she does not go Monday, you follow her, and he named a second deposit without a figure.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Confirmed Monday, and said you would follow if she stays.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named Whitehall, the death, the boat, and a second deposit with no figure.

entities.name: Ambrose Kettleby
entities.context: Not on the line. His boy had already brought the Monday word.

entities.name: Davy Gannet
entities.context: Not on the line. The tilt-boat is his, and the deposit was not spoken as a number.

facets.activity: Told Heminges she goes back on Monday

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Will? John. From Aldermanbury, with eleven pair of hose drying before the fire.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Monday. Good. Then the tilt-boat stands.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Then we follow the Queen, John, like everybody else.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Item, a second deposit. God keep you.
